name: jev-effort-router
description: Picks the reasoning effort of the main loop for each prompt with TypeSafe's Jev, in both directions, leaving the model alone. Toggle with /auto-effort on|off|status. Adapted from jev-model-router (claude-code-templates, MIT).

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; with none set the engine's built-in classifier is used instead

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

maxEffort.title: Highest effort
maxEffort.description: The most reasoning the router will ever ask for

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure the decision must be to raise the effort

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure it must be to lower the effort

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a decision before letting the turn through unchanged

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each decision to the session log
